mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact complex rational circle product average from independent residues at a=0 and two nonzero complex a; exact weighted swap, cubic, quartic and total drift bounds at four ordered pairs of an explicit 64-dimensional real unitary.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SymPy Gaussian-rational residues, exact Python integers and Fraction. NumPy int64 matrix products have explicit fixture bounds below 2^63.
mathematics.conventions: K=P^2, P=|S|^2; coordinate picked uniformly among all u and K frozen if an endpoint is selected.
non_claims: No finite check proves the general drift theorem.
No higher moments, trajectory concentration, all-time flatness or BGS theorem.
No world priority or analytic Lean claim.
